column1: # hs-pkgs-1122: random's own interface control (bin/repr-haskell lib-check --package random --ifaces own): none here. random is a Hackage
# package (test/haskell/hackage.edn) and the pack haskell-ifaces-ghc-9.14.1 holds no GHC interface of its modules, so no SUBJECT
# can be judged against an OTHER's GHC interface (its binders are judged 0 of 0 too), as ghc-platform's control file says.
